description: Routine belt replacement on conveyor C-12. Scheduled during planned downtime. No production impact.
Pneumatic actuator on station S-04 showing intermittent pressure drops. Replaced O-ring seal. Resolved same shift.
Annual preventive maintenance on M-07 weld station completed. All readings nominal. Drift at 0.2%.

M-07 weld station calibration drift alert triggered. Drift reading 1.2%, above the 1.0% threshold. Technician Rodriguez performed interim adjustment but drift re-appeared within 48 hours. Root cause suspected: worn servo motor encoder on weld arm axis 2.

URGENT: M-07 drift now at 2.1% and climbing. Interim calibration adjustments are not holding. QC reports increasing weld seam failures. Replacement servo encoder ordered from OEM — estimated 3-week lead time.

CRITICAL: M-07 calibration drift at 3.4%. First-pass yield on Line 3 has dropped to approximately 82%. Weld defect rate at housing seam station is 5x normal. Temporary manual inspection checkpoint installed downstream. Awaiting OEM encoder shipment.
M-07 drift at 4.1%. Production manager considering diverting Line 3 Model-A production to Line 1 temporarily. OEM part ETA updated to Feb 18. Cost impact estimated at $45k/week in rework and scrap.

M-07 drift peaked at 4.8%. Emergency decision: Line 3 production rate reduced by 20% to lower defect volume while awaiting encoder replacement. Inline QC checkpoint catching ~70% of defects before final assembly.
Scheduled lubrication of all weld station servos. All readings within spec. No issues found.
Routine inspection of Southeast Plant Line 3. All machines nominal. No calibration drift detected.
